𝗣𝗔𝗞 𝘃 𝗦𝗟 𝟮𝗡𝗗 𝗧𝗘𝗦𝗧 𝗧𝗢𝗠𝗢𝗥𝗥𝗢𝗪! 🇵🇰🇱🇰

Series is 0-0 after a high-scoring Rawalpindi draw.
Dhananjaya made 167; Saud Shakeel fell for 93 and 97.

Who takes the lead? 👇

#PAKvSL #Cricket

𝗣𝗔𝗞 𝘃 𝗦𝗟 𝟮𝗡𝗗 𝗧𝗘𝗦𝗧 𝗞𝗔𝗟! 🇵🇰🇱🇰🏏

👉 Rawalpindi ka 1st Test draw raha, series 0-0
👉 Dhananjaya de Silva ka 167, Sri Lanka 446
👉 Saud Shakeel 93 aur 97 par out hue, dono baar shatak se chook gaye
👉 2nd Test 17-21 November, Rawalpindi

Series mein lead kaun lega? Comment karo 👇
